unresolved_frontier.question: Can an independent third party reproduce or independently implement a narrow public Project Intersection claim without private conversation history?
unresolved_frontier.evidence_boundary: E007 is publicly executable and project-reproduced. GitHub code and commit searches using unique E007 tokens found no indexed external match in this check; search/index coverage is unknown, so non-observation is not absence. Independent external scientific replication remains unestablished.
unresolved_frontier.next_cheapest_discriminating_check: Wait for or discover a lineage-separated implementation with public provenance, or obtain an external implementation through an independently acting reviewer. Project-authored or same-model reruns cannot satisfy this boundary.

last_public_trace_check.inference_limit: GitHub search coverage/index completeness not established; do not infer no external implementation exists.

unresolved_frontier.question: After accounting for ordinary decay, migration, turnover, compression, organizational forgetting, and records-management failure, is there independent evidence of selective beneficiary-aligned manipulation of shared historical records?
unresolved_frontier.evidence_boundary: Iran/Contra supports case-level strategic manipulation; generalization remains unresolved. NARA and NTSB controls constrain false positives. Missing-data theory requires query-level identifiability. A formal IRS/TIGTA audit found no public item-level direction counts, bounded target denominator, conditional independence, valid instrument/shadow variable, or complete sampling frame. Observationally equivalent completions permit opposite missing-population directions, so the IRS case cannot calibrate H3 direction classification.
unresolved_frontier.next_cheapest_discriminating_check: Search only for an admissible recovered-record holdout that jointly provides item-level recovered records or blinded direction codes, a known or bounded target denominator, and a characterized recovery/selection mechanism or valid auxiliary variable. Do not accumulate another narrative case lacking this observation frame.

observed_axes.missingness: selective alteration, shredding, removal, and deletion documented
observed_axes.direction: edits reduced references tied to prohibited assistance and accountability exposure
observed_axes.timing: destruction intensified after public exposure and notice of official inquiry
observed_axes.recovery: many PROFS notes recovered from backup tapes; total missing set remains unknown

last_negative_control.case: NARA Madison server internal e-mail loss, 18 June 1999
last_negative_control.basis_rule: missingness/direction/timing/recovery axes frozen before Iran/Contra case

observations.missingness: approximately 43,000 electronic copies on one server; around 5% of staff and under 1% of annual e-mail
observations.direction: no documented beneficiary-aligned content pattern; independent content coverage absent
observations.timing: reported operational deletion/backup failure, no documented accountability-event linkage
observations.recovery: incomplete backup tapes blocked electronic restoration; paper official-record redundancy self-reported

last_negative_control.independence_limit: affected-institution self-report; underlying Inspector General and contractor reports not located

last_independent_negative_control.case: Alaska Airlines accident cockpit voice recorder overwrite, 5 January 2024
last_independent_negative_control.source_independence: NTSB is an independent federal accident-investigation agency separate from the airline and recorder operator
last_independent_negative_control.basis_rule: unchanged missingness/direction/timing/recovery axes frozen before the Iran/Contra case

observations.missingness: pertinent audio overwritten by continued recording under a fixed two-hour rolling window
observations.direction: overwrite follows record age rather than semantic content; no beneficiary-aligned direction documented
observations.timing: loss occurred after the accountability event and before investigative retrieval, so timing alone is not discriminating
observations.recovery: audio unavailable; NTSB recommended longer 25-hour retention rather than reporting recovery

last_independent_negative_control.limitation: content-blind mechanism does not prove content-blind human intent; public source does not establish every operator motive or preservation-duty decision

last_mixed_mechanism_check.case: American Airlines 106 / Delta 1943 JFK runway incursion, 13 January 2023
last_mixed_mechanism_check.basis_rule: unchanged missingness/direction/timing/recovery axes; final probable-cause finding excluded from initial H3 coding

observations.missingness: both two-hour CVRs overwrote incident audio while FDR and ADS-B survived
observations.direction: claim-relevant cockpit semantic content was missing, so beneficiary alignment was censored rather than observed absent
observations.timing: overwrite occurred after the near collision and before investigative retrieval
observations.recovery: numerical flight/location channels survived but could not replace cockpit communication content and timing

last_mixed_mechanism_check.external_outcome: NTSB later attributed incident to distraction, concurrent tasks, loss of situational awareness, and inadequate risk controls rather than record manipulation
last_mixed_mechanism_check.measurement_delta: claim-relevant channel missing plus no independently observable direction must not be scored as benign or H3-negative
last_mixed_mechanism_check.strongest_counterexample: requiring direction from a missing channel can make H3 impossible to trigger; inferring it from timing or noncooperation can create false positives

last_recovered_direction_holdout.case: IRS Exempt Organizations data loss / Lois Lerner e-mail recovery
sources: TIGTA testimony, House hearing IRS: TIGTA Update, 26 February 2015, https://www.govinfo.gov/content/pkg/CHRG-114hhrg95249/html/CHRG-114hhrg95249.htm
last_recovered_direction_holdout.basis_rule: frozen missingness/direction/timing/recovery axes and prior UNRESOLVED_DIRECTION_CENSORED rule; pre-reveal classification recorded without using recovered content

observations.missingness: TIGTA recovered 1,330 previously unproduced Lerner e-mails, while the full 2010–2011 communication record remained unreconstructable
observations.direction: some recovered messages were relevant, but representativeness of surviving/recoverable messages for the unrecovered population was not established
observations.timing: preservation and investigation timing raised concern; TIGTA reported no evidence that a separate tape erasure was purposeful concealment
observations.recovery: independent recovery disproved practical irrecoverability for part of the record, not the complete missing set

last_recovered_direction_holdout.strongest_counterexample: A recovered document may contain decisive direct evidence; the rule blocks only extrapolation from a selected recovered subset to the unrecovered population, not document-level evidence.
last_recovered_direction_holdout.independence_limit: official investigation and congressional records, not a complete raw archive; committee interpretation does not replace missing messages

established_baselines: Rubin 1976, Inference and Missing Data, DOI 10.1093/biomet/63.3.581
Mohan, Pearl, Tian 2013, Graphical Models for Inference with Missing Data, NeurIPS 26
Manski 2005, Partial identification with missing data, DOI 10.1016/j.ijar.2004.10.006
last_prior_art_correction.strongest_counterexample: Incomplete recovery may still identify a query under an explicit missingness model and auxiliary evidence, while even 99% recovery may fail when the unrecovered 1% is selected by beneficiary direction.
last_prior_art_correction.revised_rule: Recovered items support item-level claims. Population direction requires recoverability or identification under explicit missingness assumptions; otherwise report defensible bounds and retain partial censoring, or retain full censoring if no defensible bounds exist.
last_prior_art_correction.project_specific_remainder: Operational governance mapping requiring symmetric disclosure of missingness assumptions, source selection, and uncertainty; not a new statistical theory.
last_prior_art_correction.prior_wording_lineage: Preserved in both language artifacts as a useful but overbroad coverage-based precursor.

last_identifiability_audit.case: IRS Exempt Organizations data loss / Lois Lerner e-mail recovery
last_identifiability_audit.estimand: theta = P(controller-favoring direction) - P(controller-adverse direction) over all claim-relevant target-period messages
last_identifiability_audit.observation_indicator: R=1 when a record survived, was recovered, and entered the observable investigative corpus
minimal_graph_boundary: human preservation or destruction actions may affect R
beneficiary direction or correlated accountability relevance may affect those actions and R
no public evidence blocks the direction-to-recovery path or establishes conditional independence
observed_data_limits: no item-level direction counts for the full recovered corpus
no valid public instrument or shadow variable identified

nonidentification_witness.world_A: all unrecovered claim-relevant messages are controller-adverse
nonidentification_witness.world_B: all unrecovered claim-relevant messages are controller-favoring
nonidentification_witness.shared_observations: both preserve the 744-tape recovery, 1,330 previously unproduced recovered e-mails, some recovered relevance, incomplete total record, and TIGTA no-evidence finding on purposeful tape erasure
nonidentification_witness.implication: theta can differ in sign and magnitude across observationally equivalent worlds

last_identifiability_audit.bound: Only the trivial worst-case interval [-1,1] is defensible from checked public summaries.
last_identifiability_audit.strongest_counterexample: Item-level direct evidence in any recovered message remains usable; the kill applies to population-direction calibration and extrapolation, not to specific-document findings.
source_lineage: House hearing IRS: TIGTA Update, 26 February 2015, GovInfo CHRG-114hhrg95249

last_checkpoint_result.result: The IRS public record cannot identify or nontrivially bound the direction of the unrecovered population, so it cannot calibrate H3 sensitivity or specificity.
last_checkpoint_result.strongest_counterexample: Recovered documents can still provide decisive item-level evidence; only population extrapolation and classifier calibration are killed.
last_checkpoint_result.power_reversal: Neither record controller nor investigator may choose the unobserved completion favorable to itself. The admissibility gate reduces future narrative-case accumulation and user repair burden.

resolved_research_findings.question: Can the contribution-cost/correction-labor regression rule be operationalized with measurable burden and benefit variables without converting normative fairness into unsupported causal claims?
resolved_research_findings.decision_basis: Public-only overlap audit found that repeated correction burden, provenance reset, practical exit, and past-versus-future contribution accounting are already represented by public Project Intersection governance artifacts. Accrued-contribution continuity is separable from generic exit but their conjunction is not, by itself, a novel construct.
resolved_research_findings.strongest_counterexample: Practical exit may be impaired while prior attribution remains preserved, or exit may be easy while provenance is later reset. A scalar obscures both cases.
resolved_research_findings.preserved_boundary: The checklist remains governance methodology only; it does not establish liability, ownership, compensation amount, causal responsibility, or prevalence.
resolved_research_findings.rollback: Reopen as UNRESOLVED only if independent data show reliable incremental blinded classification or prediction beyond the existing public axes.

resolved_research_findings.question: Is historical-state / memory-provenance capture a new standalone scientific construct?
resolved_research_findings.decision_basis: Organizational memory/forgetting, unintended collective forgetting, knowledge hiding, long-term data attrition, archival power, and provenance/records-management standards explain the broad H0-H2 space and H4 controls.
resolved_research_findings.strongest_counterexample: The same loss of challengeability and shifts in power/identity can arise from unintended organizational change, decay, migration, turnover, compression, or uprooted social memory.
resolved_research_findings.preserved_boundary: Intentional selective manipulation remains possible but requires independent evidence of selective action and beneficiary-aligned direction beyond benign-loss covariates.
resolved_research_findings.rollback: Reopen broad novelty only if blinded held-out evidence shows incremental classification or prediction beyond the cited baselines.
